shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Diffuse separation for cards over the page background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); padding: 10px 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .42; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action such as install or download.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 15px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); padding: 10px 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Tool Button
components.description: Selected brush or eraser tool state.
components.css: .ds-tool-active { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--accent); padding: 10px 8px; font: inherit; font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Dark inset field used by select, textarea, and color controls.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-inset); color: var(--text); padding: 12px; resize: vertical; font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary grouping surface for each stage of the editing workflow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(23,26,29,.94); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }

narrative.overview: A dark, mobile-first utility interface for a direct photo-editing workflow. It uses layered near-black surfaces, a single lime interaction accent, rounded controls, explicit operating states, and restrained depth.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral layered surfaces with one high-salience lime accent.
Mobile-first single-column flow that expands controls at 720px.
Rounded cards and controls with compact, touch-oriented sizing.
Persistent emphasis on local processing, explicit status, and before/after comparison.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only high-salience interaction color in the current PWA; do not introduce a second competing action accent without a deliberate redesign.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: The current implementation uses one sans-serif family stack throughout; type hierarchy is created without introducing a second family.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation distinguishes persistent chrome, cards, and media workspaces; it is not used as decoration on every control.

dos: Do preserve the existing dark neutral hierarchy and use lime for primary/active emphasis.
Do keep root PWA controls touch-oriented, including the incumbent button minimum height.
Do preserve the mobile-first flow and the observed 720px control-layout breakpoint unless responsive behavior is intentionally redesigned.
Do keep status and privacy/local-processing copy visually legible as part of the operating workflow.
donts: Don't treat the duplicated ai-space-generator-pages/ files as separate design evidence; they are deployment mirrors of the root PWA files.
Don't infer Gradio's default theme as part of this PWA design system; ai-space-generator/app.py is a separate surface.
Don't introduce new palette roles, type families, or component variants as if they were incumbent tokens without implementation evidence.
Don't promote one-off values to reusable tokens solely because the same number appears in unrelated layout contexts.
